interview.hardest_part: Learning boss patterns and executing precise combat and platforming through screenshots separated by 0.4-second inputs. Each action can span an attack cue and its damage window, limiting opportunities to react. Navigation and retries also consume the three-hour wall-clock budget.
interview.likely_failure: Repeated deaths at Moss Mother or later at Bell Beast, followed by time lost retracing rooms and recovering resources. I expect to obtain substantial exploration, enemy-kill, currency, and interaction progress, but may stall before reaching Deep Docks and acquiring Swift Step. Full completion also requires finding every scored side interaction and resource threshold.
interview.helpful_mechanics: The game pauses while I think, allowing careful screenshot inspection. Death preserves broader progress and permits continued attempts within the run. Benches restore health and shorten return trips; attacking replenishes silk for healing. Many scoring milestones reward incremental exploration and ordinary combat, and rosaries in the cocoon still count toward their thresholds.
interview.harmful_mechanics: Coarse action intervals make spacing, short jumps, dodges, and healing windows difficult to control. Every step requires an arrow direction, complicating stationary positioning. Dash is unavailable initially, silk healing depends on attacking enemies, and deaths before establishing a nearby bench can force lengthy repeated traversal. Connected rooms and ability gates can cause costly navigation mistakes.
